§6Random TP§f

§aSpawn area looks like a crater field? Time to relocate.§f
Type §9/rtp§f in chat and you’ll warp to a random spot between §c256§f and §c1,024 blocks§f away. The system searches for a safe landing spot, so you won’t end up inside a wall or above a lava lake.

There’s a §c5-minute cooldown§f between teleports, so pick your landing zone wisely. Same dimension only, no cross-dimensional shenanigans.

Great for escaping over-mined terrain around spawn and finding fresh resource nodes far away. Or just for exploring when you’re bored.

§ePS:§f Always carry a bed or sleeping bag when you RTP. You never know where you’ll end up, and it might be a long walk back.
